svg.text: Flywheel — the tracker names every object, but each pass reads its state back from four stores
intent ⊃ elaboration ⊃ question · bolt ⊃ unit ⊃ work item · one session per batch · the batch is the card the operator sees
re-rendered in place · answered by phone

g.text: open until the operator closes it
units built inside · lands to main once
born a plan card · tasks as sub-issues
closed: merged, then done at the landing
written live · archived at the close
built · merged · archived read from git

svg.text: closed at merge · reaped on retire

g.text: one bus, four stores: a pass re-derives each object's state from all of them — no table says which store decides a state
